title: MS60005: Science And Technology Of Semiconductors
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Pre-requisite: None
Basic Materials Science; Classification of materials by consideration of
electrical properties, introduction to band theory, energy band diagrams,
nature of chemical bonds and their relation to crystal structure of
semiconductors
elemental and compound semiconductors. Band gap, Fermi level
carrier mobility and scattering; temperature dependent conductivity
intrinsic
and extrinsic (doped) semiconductors; preparation and doping techniques of
elemental and compound semiconductors and their characterization; narrow and
wide band gap semiconductors; thermo electric, magnetic and optical properties;
different types of semiconductors and their application in commercial devices:
Ge, Si, GaAs, InP, PbS, HgxCd1 xTe.
